chosen_titles.rationale: California Government Code Title 9 (Political Reform Act) contains the lobbying-disclosure regime (Ch. 6 Lobbyists §§86100-86205, Ch. 2 Definitions §§82000-82054.5, Ch. 11 Auditing/Enforcement).

notes: CA 2025 vintage available on Justia. Following the 2015 ground-truth regime layout: Government Code -> Title 9 (Political Reform) -> chapters 2 (definitions), 6 (lobbyists), 11 (enforcement).
